<td class="text"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:bold;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">10. Subsequent Events</span><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:105pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">The Separation</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:129pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:82.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">On July 1, 2026, S&amp;P Global completed the Separation of Mobility Global by means of a tax-free, pro-rata </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:141pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">distribution of </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:117.9pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">100%</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:141.23000000000002pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> of common stock of Mobility Global to S&amp;P Global&#8217;s existing shareholders as of June 15, 2026 (the </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:153pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">&#8220;Distribution&#8221;), </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:123.98pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">and the transfer of certain assets and liabilities of the Spin Business to Mobility Global</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:470.8pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">. On July 1, 2026, </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:165pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">S&amp;P Global distributed one share of Mobility Global common stock for every share of S&amp;P Global common stock held as </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:177pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">of the close of business on June 15, 2026, the record date for the Distribution. On July 1, 2026, Mobility Global became an </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:189pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">independent, publicly traded company under the stock symbol &#8220;MBGL&#8221; on the New York Stock Exchange. S&amp;P Global </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:201pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">retained no ownership interest in Mobility Global. </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:225pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:82.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">As of the date of Separation, the primary source of cash on hand was generated by operations and net proceeds from </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:237pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">the issuance of the Senior Notes, after payment of a </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:267.41999999999996pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">$2.0&#160;billion</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:313.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> dividend to S&amp;P Global as consideration for the transfer of </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:249pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">certain assets, liabilities and entities to Mobility Global in connection with the Separation. See </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:437.99pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Note 4&#8201;&#8212;&#8201;Debt</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:497.83pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> for further </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:261pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">discussion.</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:285pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:82.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Mobility Global and S&amp;P Global entered a Separation and Distribution Agreement and several other agreements to </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:297pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">effect the Separation and provide a framework for Mobility Global&#8217;s relationship with S&amp;P Global after the Separation. </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:309pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">These agreements provide for the allocation between Mobility Global and S&amp;P Global of the assets, liabilities and </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:321pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">obligations of S&amp;P Global and its subsidiaries, and will govern the relationship between Mobility Global and S&amp;P Global </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:333pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">after the Separation. In addition to the Separation and Distribution Agreement, the other agreements that were entered into </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:345pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">with S&amp;P Global include the Tax Matters Agreement, Transition Services Agreement, Employee Matters Agreement, and </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:357pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">other commercial arrangements</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:184.97pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">. Following the Separation, the Company expects to rely on S&amp;P Global for certain </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:369pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">transitional services under the Transition Services Agreement, including for information technology, finance, and human </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:381pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">resources. Costs associated with these services will be incurred on a different basis than historical allocations, and are </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:393pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">expected to decline as processes are transitioned to Mobility Global. In addition, the Company expects to incur incremental </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:405pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">stand-alone public company and corporate costs. As a result, historical results are not necessarily indicative of future </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:417pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">operating results.</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:441pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:82.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">The Compan</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:134.32999999999998pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">y adopted the 2026 Long Term Incentive Plan (the</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:336.34000000000003pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> &#8220;Stock</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:366.03pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> Plan</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:386.29pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">&#8221;)</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:394.05pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">. Outstanding S&amp;P Global equity </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:453pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">awards held by individuals employed by or providing services to Mobility Global, or whose employment transferred to </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:465pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Mobility Global in connection with and prior to the Separation, were converted into Mobility Global equity awards under </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:477pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">the Stock Plan in a manner that preserved intrinsic value based on the relative value of S&amp;P Global common stock before </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:489pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">the Distribution and Mobility Global&#8217;s common stock after the Distribution. The terms of the converted equity awards, </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:501pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">including the grant period and vesting schedule, generally remained unchan</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:360.92pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">ged.</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:525pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Dividend</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:549pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:82.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">In August 2026, the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:420.46pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">$0.06</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:442.96pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> per share of common </span></div><div serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">stock to common stockholders of record at the close of business on August 27, 2026, payable on September 10, 2026.</span></div><span></span>

<tr><td><div class="body" style="padding: 2px;">
<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for significant events or transactions that occurred after the balance sheet date through the date the financial statements were issued or the date the financial statements were available to be issued. Examples include: the sale of a capital stock issue, purchase of a business, settlement of litigation, catastrophic loss, significant foreign exchange rate changes, loans to insiders or affiliates, and transactions not in the ordinary course of business.</p></div>
